note: Which target a hunter chases. The runner is always a candidate. NPC bots are candidates only on the difficulties whose bot_targets flag is true, and only when within bot_range (and, with bot_line_of_sight, in line of sight). The hunter picks the candidate with the smallest distance divided by its weight. Standard keeps bots off, so the route plays as before. Read by hunters/brain.rs (TargetRules).
